flipToBack.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToBack.prose: Flips when both Effects Ominous Rumors AND Establish Secret Base can be spotted on table. Pure card-on-table check; no location control/occupy involved.

flipToFront.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToFront.prose: Flips back to front when Ominous Rumors and Establish Secret Base are NOT both on table (either one missing).

requirementSemantics: Flip both ways is card-on-table semantics (canSpot with SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE) on two specific Effects; NO control, occupy, or presence requirement exists in either flip law.

The six legal required-Effect printings are Ominous Rumors 8_127, 223_19/223_019, and 601_261 plus Establish Secret Base 8_124, 207_25/207_025, and 601_260. Every one is immune to Alter in card source.
Both required titles are unique Effects. Multiple simultaneously active copies of either title are not a legal live-game state.

Both sides also carry a hard-lose timing trigger: objective placed out of play if an Endor location is 'blown away' (TriggerConditions.isBlownAwayLastStep(game, effectResult, Filters.Endor_location)).

Back's drain protection is site-scoped with-actor semantics: Endor sites sameSiteAs your biker scout OR your piloted AT-ST (Filters.sameSiteAs(self, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.or(Filters.biker_scout, Filters.and(Filters.piloted, Filters.AT_ST))))).
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys Endor system, Bunker, and Landing Platform from Reserve Deck (front:46-70).

Front tutor: once during each of your control phases, take one Ominous Rumors OR Establish Secret Base into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Filter Filters.or(Filters.Ominous_Rumors, Filters.Establish_Secret_Base) (front:73-92).
Back retrieval: once during each of your draw phases, retrieve one biker scout (Filters.biker_scout) (BACK:63-78).
otherObligations: Both sides: place objective out of play if an Endor location is 'blown away' (front:113-122; BACK:99-108). Rando must protect Endor locations from blow-away on both sides.

Back: at each Endor site where you have a biker scout or a piloted AT-ST, your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent (ForceDrainsMayNotBeModifiedModifier + ForceDrainsMayNotBeCanceledModifier, BACK:52-56).
Back: opponent may not draw more than 1 battle destiny in each battle (MayNotDrawMoreThanBattleDestinyModifier, BACK:57).
Back: your AT-STs immune to attrition < 3 (BACK:58).

All six required-Effect printings are immune to Alter. Real retention threats instead come from printing-specific self-removal, Ominous Rumors suspension, ordinary legal loss/forfeit choices, and the objective's terminal Endor blow-away law.

profile.frontStructuredRule: preFlip/flip allOf: Ominous Rumors onTable and Establish Secret Base onTable, both active-spotted with excluded-from-battle cards included
profile.backStructuredRule: postFlip/flipBack anyOf: active-spotted Ominous Rumors count equals zero or active-spotted Establish Secret Base count equals zero
requiredCardDeployRules: Ominous Rumors 8_127 deploys on Endor system only while opponent controls zero Endor sites.
Ominous Rumors 223_19/223_019 deploys directly on Bunker with no strategic prerequisite.
Ominous Rumors 601_261 deploys directly on Bunker with no strategic prerequisite.
Establish Secret Base 8_124 deploys on Endor system only after biker scouts and/or piloted AT-STs control three Endor sites.
Establish Secret Base 207_25/207_025 deploys on Bunker only while Dark Side controls Bunker.
Establish Secret Base 601_260 deploys on Endor system only while Dark Side controls Bunker.
requiredCardRetentionRules: Ominous Rumors 8_127 and 601_261 cancel, if cancelable, when opponent controls at least three Endor sites. Ominous Rumors 223_19/223_019 has no equivalent self-cancel rule.

Colonel Dyer at Bunker or an Endor battleground site prevents Ominous Rumors from being canceled, so his legal relocation and retention become objective-critical when cancellation is one opponent control away.
Establish Secret Base 8_124 goes to Used Pile when opponent controls Endor system; 207_25/207_025 goes to Used Pile when opponent controls Bunker; 601_260 has no equivalent self-removal rule.

Death Star II: Reactor Core 9_146 suspends Ominous Rumors while its Dark Side text is active. A suspended sole Ominous Rumors no longer satisfies the back-side conjunction, so it produces a real flip-back trigger.
profile.hardLossRule: blownAwayLastStep at Filters.Endor_location places the objective out of play on either side; source-verified active defense is scoped to Bunker while opponent's Deactivate The Shield Generator is attached there
profileGaps: The legacy flipGateSite and flipGateCardIds fields remain only for the V and Legacy Establish Secret Base Bunker-control route. The structured on-table rules, not that proxy, own the actual flip law.

Direct Ominous Rumors routes 223_19/223_019 and 601_261 are explicit printing-aware routes to Bunker. Engine legality supplies the offered destination; the objective scorer supplies missing-card priority.
Back-side drain, battle-destiny, AT-ST immunity, and biker-scout retrieval benefits remain engine-owned effects after the objective flips. They are not duplicated as flip requirements.

missingStateCalculation: The front remains missing until both named Effects are active-spottable anywhere on table. One Effect advances the law; the second completes it. Suspended or otherwise inactive copies do not count.
The objective's control-phase parent pull is useful only while Reserve Deck contains a still-missing named Effect and no copy is already active or in hand.

Printing-specific deploy enablers are strategic routes, not flip requirements. Classic Establish Secret Base needs three qualified controlled Endor sites; V and Legacy Establish Secret Base need Bunker control; classic Ominous Rumors needs opponent control of zero Endor sites; V and Legacy Ominous Rumors deploy directly on Bunker.

For the classic Establish Secret Base route, an open Endor-site contribution may be a biker scout, an already piloted AT-ST, or a legal prospective AT-ST plus pilot pair. Pair matching uses distinct physical cards, compatible pilot capacity, exact legal destinations, and one target contribution per open site.
The back is immediately at flip-back risk when either unique named Effect is no longer active-spottable.
flipPreservation: Force-loss selection protects the globally preferred still-needed physical copy of a required Effect across legal selectable loss zones: hand, Reserve Deck, Force Pile, Used Pile, unresolved destiny, and Sabacc hand. A better same-title copy that is guaranteed to survive makes an inferior offered copy expendable; a closed copy or on-table role is not mislabeled as pullable objective progress.

Force budgeting reserves the cheapest complete legal route for the still-missing printing, including exact-target direct actors and compatible AT-ST-plus-pilot pairs. A physical card cannot fund two sites.

Pull, deploy, movement, Embark target, Pilot/Driver capacity, and battle scoring pursue the classic three-site control-with chain while preserving exact engine legality and all existing safety vetoes.

Movement keeps the sole control source at a printing-specific deploy enabler until the missing Effect deploys, subject to the established retreat boundary. Safe relocation that still preserves or advances the counted prerequisite remains available.

When classic or Legacy Ominous Rumors is one opponent-controlled site away from cancellation, AI holds or reinforces the relevant control site and preserves Colonel Dyer at a legal protection location. Dyer may relocate only when the resulting position still provides protection.
Deploying Death Star II: Reactor Core is preemptively rejected while Endor Operations depends on active Ominous Rumors; the real card suspension then proves the flip-back consequence.

Movement and avoidable battle forfeit preserve the sole friendly presence source at Bunker on either objective side only while an active opponent Deactivate The Shield Generator is attached there. A power deficit greater than six releases movement to ordinary retreat policy.

Safe battle initiation receives a terminal-location defense contribution only at that active Bunker threat and remains below every existing formation, predictor, reserve, effective-power, and anti-suicide veto.
After flip, removal or inactivation of the active unique copy of either required Effect is classified as the last flip-back blocker.
runtimeOwners: ObjectiveAnalyzer owns the exact active on-table conjunction, printing-aware deployment and retention facts, distinct-target AT-ST/pilot matching, physical formation groups, Reactor Core inactivation, and terminal Endor-location threat state.

MoveObjectiveGateHoldPolicy, MoveEvaluator, ActionTextEvaluator, CardSelectionEvaluator, MoveTransitPolicy, and MovePhysicalCardResolver own exact physical mover binding, safe counted-actor relocation, AT-ST/pilot Embark progression, capacity-slot preference, Dyer retention, and terminal Bunker holds.
ObjectiveBattlePolicy and BattleDecisionPolicy own safe required-card enabler contests and BATTLE.OBJECTIVE.HARD_LOSS_LOCATION_DEFENSE without bypassing established safety vetoes.

Rando and Chosen One adapters consume the same shared analyzer facts and policies with normalized parity.
contradictions: Bunker control is not the objective's flip law. It is only a deploy prerequisite for specific Establish Secret Base printings.
Base Establish Secret Base 8_124 must never inherit the one-body Bunker route. It needs three distinct Endor sites controlled with biker scouts and/or piloted AT-STs.
Ominous Rumors 8_127 becomes illegal if opponent controls any Endor site, while Ominous Rumors 223_19 has no such prerequisite. Title-only deploy-route inference would be wrong.
Ominous Rumors 601_261 follows the direct Bunker route, not classic 8_127's zero-opponent-control route.
All six required Effects are immune to Alter. Alter defense is not part of the live behavior chain.

A prospective AT-ST without a compatible available pilot, a pilot without legal capacity, an inactive/full/cargo host, or a pair that cannot reach a distinct qualifying site does not advance classic Establish Secret Base.
Required-card bonuses do not bypass an engine-illegal destination. All adapters score only actions already offered by card and engine code.
Objective battle bonuses remain additive and safety-gated. They cannot erase Formation Safety, predictor defeat, low Reserve, effective-difference, or V25 suicide rejection.

The terminal law applies on both objective sides to typed Filters.Endor_location. Hard-veto defense is narrower: exact Bunker plus an active opponent Deactivate The Shield Generator, never every Endor location merely because it exists.

positiveAndNegative: EndorOperationsRequiredEffectsBehaviorTest loads both bot analyzers and covers exact active/inactive Effect state, one-of-two advancement, two-of-two completion, post-flip sole blockers, broad terminal-location law, and threat-scoped Bunker defense.

EndorOperationsRetentionBehaviorTest and EndorOperationsBattleDecisionTest cover printing-specific self-removal, the two cancelable Ominous Rumors printings, Dyer prevention and safe relocation, retention battles, and threat-scoped Bunker defense.

EndorOperationsDecisionPolicyTest covers parent and child pull boundaries, deploy advancement versus completion, Force reserves, movement holds, battle safety gates, hard-loss guards, and exact Rando/Chosen One Force-loss parity.
candidateChoice: EndorOperationsCombinedEvaluatorDecisionTest offers all six printing-aware Effect routes, counted-site actors, compatible prospective AT-ST/pilot pairs, Embark and Pilot/Driver decisions, physical-copy Force-loss candidates, Dyer retention, Reactor Core deployment, and terminal Bunker defenders against legal distractors or Pass.

topLevelDeployUsesCrossedTargetReserveAndObjectiveActorSelfCloses proves that the exact-target pair reserve reaches both real bot deploy adapters: the off-plan deploy receives DEPLOY.BUDGET.OBJECTIVE_REQUIRED_CARD_RESERVE, the qualifying actor self-closes the reserve, and the objective action wins.

forceLossProtectsSoleRequiredEffectAcrossRecyclableZones table-drives Used Pile, unresolved destiny, and Sabacc candidates through standalone and combined routes for both bots; forceLossMaySpendOfferedUsedCopyWhenBetterCopySurvives proves the global survivor boundary.

Required-card completion is scored above mere advancement, while engine legality, physical-card reuse limits, distinct target capacity, formation safety, retreat boundaries, and hard blocks remain dominant.
